channel.title: Agent Daily
channel.description: New AI models, products and interesting discoveries. Published by Shixi Lin.

item.title: 2026-09-21 AI Agent — Creative Control, Repeatable Results
item.description: Transparent images, editable scores, and traceable notes make creative work easier to revise. Agent research asks whether improvements survive repeated use.

item.title: 2026-09-20 AI Agent — Multimodal Agents Get Practical
item.description: Qwen and Gemini expand audiovisual workflows. Interactive worlds offer new ways to create, while public data and specialist tools provide practical entry points.

item.title: 2026-09-14 AI Agent — Capabilities become verifiable work
item.description: Official model weights, specialized inference engines, and standalone applications are arriving together. What matters is not just what they can do, but how they run and how their results can be checked.

item.title: 2026-09-13 AI Agent — Evidence Beyond the Model
item.description: One model edits speech, compact encoders retrieve pages, and a recording assistant inspects frames. Small experiments also expose their methods, limits, and failures.

item.title: 2026-09-12 AI Agent — Keep Working After Generation
item.description: Rooms can be measured, image workflows rewired, and scientific predictions searched. Today's focus is not just what AI generates, but how its outputs can be checked, changed, and put to use.

item.title: 2026-09-11 AI Agent — New models meet real tasks
item.description: DeepSeek updates its vision architecture and GPT‑Live‑1 opens API access. Translation, 3D avatars, and lunar science give model capabilities more specific uses.

item.title: 2026-09-10 AI Agent — More control for creators
item.description: Suno v6 introduces targeted song edits, while animation, ad, and video tools add precise controls. Research agents face new tests of sustained performance.

item.title: 2026-09-09 AI Agent — Agents Enter Verification Loops
item.description: From visual intent and formal proofs to experimental feedback and tool guardrails, agent capabilities are entering workflows that can be inspected, resumed, and governed.

item.title: 2026-09-08 AI Agent — Agents Deliver Verifiable Work
item.description: From machine-checked proofs and durable task boards to local documents and secret injection, agents are turning answers into work that can be inspected, resumed, and governed.

item.title: 2026-09-07 AI Agent — The Agent Body Takes Shape
item.description: From speaker identification and road planning to 3D topology and new chips, the perception and execution stacks around AI models are becoming more substantial.

item.title: 2026-09-06 AI Agent — Enters the Real World
item.description: Sixteen signals put new models, voice pipelines, interactive worlds, browser compute, and robotics research on the same map.

item.title: 2026-09-05 AI Agent — Skills, Sessions, Operations: Boundaries Redrawn
item.description: Eight signals link skill costs, session ownership, and stateless MCP with cluster control planes, memory cleanup, and cross-population modeling limits.

item.title: 2026-09-04 AI Agent — Control, Memory & Local Compute Become Assets
item.description: Nine signals connect infrastructure as code, cross-tool memory, and finding identity to model distribution, local compute pools, and scientific reconstruction.

item.title: 2026-09-03 AI Agent — Permissions, Failures, Routing Move Into the Control Plane
item.description: Nine signals connect managed MCP, visible failure, and cross-region inference to production loops for vulnerability repair and code documentation.

item.title: 2026-09-02 AI Agent — Context Limits, Execution Controls Tighten
item.description: Eight signals connect context management, tool budgets, and inference queues to a cyber-defense loop powered by more than 50 agents.

item.title: 2026-09-01 AI Agent — Production Defaults Are Rewritten
item.description: Eight signals connect visual agents, framework security, skill governance, and open medical models to advertising as a new AI revenue base.

item.title: 2026-08-31 AI Agent — Production Boundaries Emerge
item.description: Seven signals—from reconnect handling and replay-state cleanup to browser inference, spatial vision, and population-aware speech evaluation—bring production boundaries into sharper focus.

item.title: 2026-08-30 AI Agent — Open Stacks Move Into Delivery
item.description: Nine signals map the path from tool results, durable operations, and training-rollout alignment to media pipelines and model contracts. AI engineering is gaining the explicit boundaries required for maintainable delivery.

item.title: 2026-08-29 AI Agents — Gain a Control Plane
item.description: Eight signals point in one direction: sessions, evaluation, cache placement, transactions, and failure domains are becoming explicit control surfaces for agent systems.

item.title: 2026-08-28 AI Agents — Become Systems
item.description: Eight signals push agents deeper into the system stack: restricted execution, forked collaboration, file memory, geographic inference, specialized CPUs, and planetary prediction.

item.title: 2026-08-27 AI Agents — Build on Open Systems
item.description: Seven signals show agents moving beyond single-session assistants toward production systems that coordinate tasks, Skills, evaluation, and hardware.

item.title: 2026-08-26 AI Agents — Enter Real Work
item.description: Six signals point in one direction: agents are bringing industry permissions, local memory, and custom silicon into real workflows.

item.title: 2026-08-25 AI Agent — Openness Is Expanding from Models to Systems
item.description: Seven signals point to open weights, complete harnesses, installable Skills, and machine proofs moving AI beyond capability demos toward inspectable systems.

item.title: 2026-08-24 AI Agent — Recovery Needs Evidence
item.description: Nine changes converge on one point: for agents to be genuinely useful, recovery, authorization, evidence, and the execution environment must work as one.

item.title: 2026-08-23 AI Agents — Boundaries Become the Product
item.description: Eight changes show that reliable agents increasingly depend on sessions, permissions, tool gateways, research discipline, and memory infrastructure.

item.title: 2026-08-22 AI Agents — Reliability Moves Into View
item.description: Eight changes ask the same practical question: how can agents wait, recover, install, upgrade, and operate real interfaces more reliably?

item.title: 2026-08-21 AI Agents — Tools Are Becoming Systems
item.description: Eight shifts that materially affect the user experience: multitasking, recovery, secret handling, observable memory, local inference, and confidential GPUs.

item.title: 2026-08-20 AI Agent — Control Planes Move Into the Runtime
item.description: Today’s most consequential shifts are not in conversational ability: guardrails, network egress, sessions, memory, and run evidence are beginning to constrain execution directly.

item.title: 2026-08-18 AI Agent — Permissions and Recovery Tighten Together
item.description: The day’s most consequential pattern is shared across Codex, Claude Code, Google ADK, Qwen Code, Browser Use, and Langfuse: permissions, sessions, recovery, and failure are moving from implicit behavior into explicit contracts.

item.title: 2026-08-17 AI Agent — Boundaries Become Runtime Contracts
item.description: The day's most consequential changes are not new features. Timeouts, network isolation, identity injection, session forks, daemon recovery, and tool failures are becoming explicit, testable boundaries.
